### 🏃 Arcade movement
- A new arcade movement profile: snappy acceleration, real air-strafing, and bunny-hopping that chains instead of bleeding speed on every landing.
- Sliding.
- Movement physics now step at a fixed 120 Hz, so how you move no longer depends on your frame rate.
- Field of view is a fixed 90° in every movement profile.
- Stepping up onto a ledge eases the view instead of snapping it.

### 🌐 Multiplayer
- Other players move more smoothly, especially on an unstable connection — their motion is now replayed on the sender's clock rather than on whenever the packet happened to arrive.

### 🔫 Visuals
- Weapons picked up depth: seams, magazine wells, trigger guards and the gaps under scopes are now shaded instead of reading as flat blocks of colour.
- The sky now lights the world — weapons, players and props take their ambient light and reflections from the actual sky above you, so they shift with the time of day.
